body: The ordinance will return to the agenda at the next regular session, unless the chair calls a special meeting first.

articles.title: Then & Now: Sycamore Road in 2004 and Today
articles.deck: A photo from the Millrace County Historical Society shows the same corner as it looked decades ago.
body: A 2004 photograph from the Millrace County Historical Society shows Sycamore Road from the corner of Ridge Drive.

Someone took the same picture from the same spot this month, holding the camera at about the same height. Most of the houses are still standing, though the porches and the trees have changed a good deal.
